integrity: Closed-form proof includes all rate ratios and evaluation times; finite numerical tests are supplementary, not a substitute for the proof; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two distinct positive real exponents; unweighted continuous half-line; specified orthogonal projection, not minimal projection. The limiting repeated-root subspace differs from the exactly collapsed rank-one subspace. Historical priority risk remains for specialized exponential-Chebyshev projection literature.
title: Sharp uniform norm and endpoint rigidity for a two-rate exponential orthoprojector
